title: Ad Testing Matrix (v3 shared contract)
description: THE shared ad-matrix contract (the contract every ads skill shares). /positioning-angles WRITES ./campaigns/<name>/ad-matrix.{md,json}; /creative and /paid-ads READ it and name assets by cell ID (e.g. MA-H2-B-9x16-v1.mp4); /performance-review maps results back to cells. 4 hooks (H1-H4, taxonomy: direct/question/proof/contrarian) x 3 formats (A=static, B=video, C=carousel) = 12 cells with IDs MA-H{1-4}-{A-C}.

matrix_name.description: Human-readable name for this test matrix, e.g. 'Spring Launch Ad Matrix'.

created_date.description: ISO 8601 date when this matrix was created.

created_by.description: The skill that created this matrix. Normally 'positioning-angles' (the writer of record).

campaign_ref.description: Path to the campaign this matrix belongs to, e.g. './campaigns/spring-launch/'.

positioning_angle.description: The positioning angle being tested across all cells.

target_audience.description: The audience segment these ads target.

destination_url.description: Landing page URL (or placeholder) all ads drive to.

hooks.description: The four hook rows. One hook per taxonomy class is the default discipline; deviate only with a reason in notes.

hook_id.description: Row identifier: H1, H2, H3, or H4.

taxonomy.description: Hook class. direct = plain benefit claim; question = opens a loop the ad answers; proof = specific result/evidence leads; contrarian = challenges the category's accepted advice.

hook_text.description: The actual hook copy or headline.

psychology.description: The persuasion principle at work, e.g. 'loss aversion', 'authority + specificity'.

voc_ref.description: Optional pointer to the voc.md quote this hook is built from.

formats.description: The three format columns: A=static, B=video, C=carousel.

format_id.description: Column identifier: A, B, or C.

format.description: Creative format. Canonical mapping: A=static, B=video, C=carousel.

platform.description: Primary platform this format is optimized for, e.g. 'Meta', 'LinkedIn', 'TikTok'.

dimensions.description: Primary aspect/dimensions, e.g. '1080x1080', '9x16'. Per-asset variants live in the asset filename (MA-H2-B-9x16-v1.mp4).

cells.description: The ad variants: one cell per hook x format intersection, up to 12.

cell_id.description: Unique cell ID, e.g. 'MA-H2-B'. Asset files are named from this: MA-H2-B-9x16-v1.mp4.

hook_id.description: Reference to the hook row used in this cell.

format_id.description: Reference to the format column used in this cell.

headline.description: Ad headline text for this variant.

body_copy.description: Ad body copy for this variant.

creative_prompt.description: Generation prompt for the creative (image, video, or carousel concept), consumed by /creative.

asset_paths.description: Paths to generated assets, named by cell ID (e.g. './campaigns/spring-launch/ads/MA-H2-B-9x16-v1.mp4').

status.description: Current production status of this cell.

results.description: Performance data mapped back to this cell by /performance-review. All fields optional; record what the platform actually reported.

spend.description: Total spend on this cell, in account currency.

conversions.description: Total conversions (as defined by the campaign goal).

notes.description: Any additional notes about this cell.

test_plan.description: How to run the test systematically.

success_metric.description: Primary metric to judge winners, e.g. 'CPA'.
